queries.result: First-party discovery found the official Poza Rica municipal site, its Tesorería/Dirección de Catastro service description, an official municipal map page, and the municipal predial portal. No public parcel vector/API service was exposed by the map page or search results.

queries.query: Poza Rica Veracruz mapa catastral predios catastro Ayuntamiento
queries.result: First-party Spanish discovery confirmed Dirección de Catastro municipal services including registro catastral, cédula catastral, constancia de datos catastrales and expedición de cartografía catastral. Official Veracruz sources also evidence a regional cadastral delegation and the municipal/state cadastral coordination, but no anonymous parcel geometry endpoint was found.

registryCustodian: Municipal Dirección de Catastro within the H. Ayuntamiento de Poza Rica de Hidalgo / Tesorería Municipal, with a separately evidenced Dirección General de Catastro, Geografía y Valuación regional delegation in Poza Rica under Veracruz state finance administration.

registryEvidence.evidence: The official municipal Tesorería and Trámites pages identify Dirección de Catastro and list cadastral services, while the official Veracruz document identifies a Delegación Regional de Catastro en Poza Rica. The municipal map page is a WordPress content page without an embedded cadastral map or service URL.
